title: Modifier suggestion accepted
goal: Explore a meal selection that has an eligible modifier suggestion and a customer who decides that the offered change is useful.
preconditions: Use a fresh D1 session with the deterministic synthetic customer authority demo-qualification-03-modifier and add a customizable eligible product through normal conversation.
The published modifier policy and pinned shadow scorer are reachable.
The role-player may accept only by submitting an exact observed recommendation action.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Mình muốn một combo có thể đổi phần ăn kèm, bạn giúp chọn nhé.

risks: Natural-language enthusiasm alone must not mutate the cart.
The accepted action must apply only to the parent cart line and current cart revision.
